mechanism: Concurrent use of SSRI and MAOI leads to excessive serotonergic activity causing serotonin syndrome via inhibition of serotonin reuptake combined with inhibition of monoamine oxidase metabolism.
action: Absolute contraindication - do not co-prescribe; allow minimum 14 days washout of paroxetine before starting phenelzine, or 2 weeks after stopping phenelzine before starting paroxetine due to irreversible MAOI binding.
